title: One Degree of Freedom Moves the Frontier, the Other Four Do Not: A Preregistered Factorization of an Active-Dendrite Repair, Its Architecture-Bound Supply, and Five Failed Escapes
description: Version 2 adds experiment R4 (a 2-layer Transformer backbone, 326 newly collected runs) to the reproduction package and updates the manuscript accordingly; everything else is unchanged from version 1. This record deposits the manuscript and the complete reproduction package for a preregistered factorization of an active-dendrite continual-learning repair into its protection-budget degrees of freedom. Across 1,539 newly collected training runs plus 60 reused controls, six preregistered experiments test five escapes and four fail: the strength of the protection, its temporal decay schedule, a forward-pass-only intervention, and the context pathway leave the frontier unchanged (R1: 24 Holm-corrected cells, minimum p = 0.585). The one degree of freedom that works -- reallocating a fixed total anchor budget toward recent tasks under exact weight conservation -- moves the Pareto frontier on its home MLP architecture (T=20: +8.08 accuracy over the un-repaired baseline while improving retention over the repair itself, Holm p = 6.4e-5, four preregistered criteria met in full), with direction specificity confirmed by a preregistered reverse-weighting arm (worse on retention in all 20/20 paired seeds, |d_z| = 4.0). The supply of this freedom is architecture-bound, now mapped on three real trunk families: on a calibrated ResNet-18+GN backbone the same reallocation reaches neither preregistered verdict level (R2T, T3), after a first-round apparent transfer (+1.94, Holm p = 0.041 at n = 10) was overturned by the preregistered sample-extension clause (n = 20: +0.72, p = 0.34) -- a flip reported in full; and in the new R4, on a 2-layer Transformer with both architecture constants re-measured from scratch (gate constant G = 0.5827 frozen by probe; lambda recalibrated to 100 by a 120-run sweep over six decades), the reallocation is again inert at n = 40 (+0.07/+0.09, n.s. at a detectable threshold near 0.2 points) while the gate normalization itself transfers cleanly (+7.01, 40/40 paired seeds positive): the two freedoms the MLP conflates separate across architectures. Every experiment ran under a written preregistration with implementation-correctness gates whose failure voids the data; eight gates fired across the program and none was resolved by relaxing a criterion; all eight are tabulated in the paper. Two independent machine-checkable verifiers are included: r_repro/verify_package.py (25 package-level checks) and paper/check_paper_numbers.py (27 paper-level checks, rebuilding the 1,539-run ledger from raw JSON).
